The man stands behind her, placing a hand on her shoulder; he is now wearing a white t-shirt with a green number '3' on it. (3) The man and girl are shown holding a large LEGO box featuring the Netflix 'One Piece' logo and a pirate ship. (4) Close-up shots of the LEGO box, showing details of the 'Going Merry' ship and minifigures. Yellow promotional text overlays appear at the top and bottom. (5) A fast-paced time-lapse sequence shows the man and girl building the LEGO ship on a white marble table. Bricks are scattered everywhere, and their hands move rapidly as the ship takes shape. (6) The completed LEGO pirate ship is displayed prominently. The camera zooms in on tiny details like the minifigures of Luffy, Zoro, and Nami on the deck, as well as opening chests and interior rooms. (7) A woman with long pink hair enters a hallway, appearing emotional and wiping away tears. The man presents her with a bouquet of pink LEGO roses in a clear glass vase. They lean their heads together in a romantic pose. (8) The young girl stands in front of a white wall, looking at the camera with her hands open in a questioning gesture, then smiles.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for a LEGO One Piece set being sold on the momo shopping platform during the 11.11 shopping festival. It uses a family-centric narrative, starting with a humorous hook about the father's 'pirate dream,' moving to a bonding activity of building the set with his daughter, and concluding with a romantic/humorous moment involving his wife to highlight the product's appeal to different family members and the attractive discounts and prizes available.
